title: "Autonomous software engineering"
claim: "LLMs show some ability to autonomously complete software engineering tasks."

**LLMs show some ability to autonomously complete software engineering tasks.**

- Frontier models can autonomously resolve 75% of a set of curated issues in software systems on github ([SWE-bench-verified](https://openai.com/index/introducing-swe-bench-verified/)).

- Frontier models can autonomously produce predictive models on 17% of Kaggle datasets with the same error as a highly skilled data scientist (bronze on [MLE-bench](https://openai.com/index/mle-bench/)).
